counterexamples.claim: The connected-head construction tasks can begin before the head they construct is finished.
counterexamples.scenario: T002–005 require T001. T001 closure includes an exact head assembly, whole-bird result, eight-view postflight and successor preservation. Unlike its T015 edge, downstream T001 edges lack a preflight-only restriction. A literal executor waits for the completed head before constructing its defining bill/crown/cheek/optic.
counterexamples.smallest_falsification_test: Paper-walk the frozen task rules from a state with only pinned baseline/source scope and owner-selected head authorization. Prove T002/T004 are dispatchable without successor bytes or completed T001 postflight.
counterexamples.test_performed: Read T001 and T002–005 JSON. T001 has no scope_slices; downstream prerequisite_dependency_scope only restricts T062. Global rule says mixed-task edges receive explicit restrictions. Thus the required paper walk cannot establish dispatch from literal full closure.
counterexamples.result: SURVIVES. This independently verifies P02-OUT04; it does not imply permission to bypass T001.
counterexamples.smallest_correction: Give T001 explicit preflight scope/ownership/authorization and postflight construction/evidence slices. Restrict all downstream T001 edges to its completed preflight slice.

counterexamples.claim: The 45-minute connected-head packet can obtain its stated owner postflight decision without implicitly requiring unrelated whole-character finish closure.
counterexamples.scenario: next_series_proposal lists T020 as head postflight owner gate. T020 depends on T012 whole-character pass and T019 material-equivalence scope. Its 26 transitive prerequisites include breast, shield-wing, rear, claws, Maker/Mechanic/Advanced finish, repair chronology, regional surfaces and strict-normal diagnosis. These unfinished outcomes are outside the selected head packet and cannot silently be imported into its shared ceiling.
counterexamples.smallest_falsification_test: Provide a head-checkpoint owner-decision slice that can record accept/reject/pending for exact head scope with body/finish/normal gaps explicitly open, while preserving a separate full G1/all-era acceptance dependency chain.
counterexamples.test_performed: Computed T020 ancestor set: T001–016 except T017, plus T018/019/T021–026/T062. Read T020 dependency and series gate fields: no checkpoint slice or edge restriction is specified; gate text says milestone acceptance, while full-decision dependencies remain broad.
counterexamples.result: SURVIVES as scope ambiguity. The dated decision may eventually be scoped, but frozen sequencing does not establish that smaller route. It is not evidence that head work closes the full mission.
counterexamples.smallest_correction: Distinguish an exact head-checkpoint owner review from final all-era whole-character acceptance. Link the former to head packet/evidence only; keep T020 full acceptance dependent on its broader tasks and retain all unmet gaps.
